== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Shiryu Mountain, also known as Mount Shiryu, is a massive formation of black [[stone]] that rises from a desert landscape. Its appearance resembles a dark, frozen wave and is characterized by the presence of ancient [[dragon]] remains; massive skeletal structures, including a serpentine skull at its base and bones stretching across the city of [[Serpent's Grave]], are integrated into the environment. The mountain features multiple peaks, including a secondary peak where certain dwellings are located and a primary summit that houses the [[Jai clan]]'s main complex, consisting of palaces for the head family and their subordinates. The terrain includes deep clefts that form miniature valleys surrounded by spire-like rock formations. While the mountain serves as a majestic landmark, it has also been subject to intense phenomena, such as a sudden eruption of black-spotted fire from its summit that briefly resembled volcanic activity.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Located within [[Serpent's Grave]], Shiryu Mountain is the site where the final [[dragons]] perished. The mountain features a main peak situated beneath the palaces of the Jai clan{{!}}Jai family, as well as a secondary peak. The [[Jai clan]] has established their homes upon the mountain, with most of the clan having retreated to its summit. Additionally, a peak on Mount Shiryu is marked by an area where flames once blasted into the sky.}}
